title: Case Study: Helicopter Racing League — Video Streaming & Real-Time ML — D6
purpose: Shows the documented internals needed to predict behavior; undocumented details are observed behavior and may change.
routing_rationale: HRL requires sub-second streaming of in-flight race telemetry (G-force, RPM, position) to augment global live video broadcasts with real-time predictive overtake AI graphics.

groups.label: Global Fan Experience & Live Video Tier

nodes.label: Helicopter Sensor Array
nodes.detail: Streams rotor RPM, airspeed, GPS coordinates, and G-force over private cellular.

nodes.label: 5G Trackside Mobile Edge
nodes.detail: Ultra-low-latency 5G edge compute gateway at racing circuit PoP.

nodes.label: Dataflow Streaming Engine
nodes.detail: Computes instantaneous race leaderboards and lap split times in under 50ms.

nodes.label: Vertex AI Overtake Predictor
nodes.detail: Predicts pass probability based on rotor aerodynamics and entry velocity.

nodes.label: Cloud CDN Live Video Cache
nodes.detail: Distributes 4K race video feeds worldwide with sub-second glass-to-glass latency.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner Live Leaderboard
nodes.detail: Delivers globally synchronized race standings to mobile fan apps worldwide.

steps.title: Ultra-Low Latency Telemetry Ingestion
steps.action: In-flight sensors stream over 5G edge into Dataflow in under 20 milliseconds.
steps.why_traversal: Provides the sub-second baseline needed for augmented reality sports broadcasting.

steps.title: Predictive AI Augmentation & Global Broadcast
steps.action: Vertex AI predicts overtakes; overlays probability onto video stream cached via Cloud CDN.
steps.why_traversal: Engages 10 million global fans with cutting-edge real-time predictive graphics.

scenarios.label: Intermittent Track Shadow Signal Loss
scenarios.root_cause: Helicopter dipped into mountain canyon, dropping 5G signal for 4 seconds.
scenarios.diverted_path: Helicopter onboard flash memory buffered telemetry; transmitted burst upon re-emergence.
scenarios.blast_radius: Dataflow event-time watermarking sorted packets correctly with zero distortion.
scenarios.recovery: Dataflow watermark handling absorbed out-of-order data automatically.
